description: This is a Java source file for a JUnit test class `ClientSavingsIntegrationTest` that contains various integration tests for the 'Savings Account' functionalities within the Apache Fineract project. The tests cover account creation, approval, activation, transactions, charges, interest posting, overdraft handling, and account closure scenarios.

classes.name: ClientSavingsIntegrationTest
classes.description: This class contains multiple integration test cases for testing savings account lifecycle, transactions, charges, interest calculations, overdraft scenarios, and account closures in Apache Fineract.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Prepares the test environment before each test, initializing REST Assured specifications and helpers.

methods.name: testSavingsAccount
methods.description: Tests creating a savings account, approving, activating, calculating interest, posting interest, and verifying updates.

methods.name: testSavingsLastTransactionAndRunningBalanceUpdate
methods.description: Validates the last transaction and running balance after interest postings and transactions.

methods.name: testSavingsBackedDatedTransactionsNotAllowed
methods.description: Verifies that backdated transactions are not permitted when global configuration disables it.

methods.name: testSavingsAccountWithMinBalanceForInterestCalculation
methods.description: Checks behavior when a minimum balance for interest calculation is set.

methods.name: testSavingsAccount_CLOSE_APPLICATION
methods.description: Tests closing a savings account, including validation for balance at closure.

methods.name: testSavingsAccount_WITH_ENFORCE_MIN_BALANCE
methods.description: Tests enforcement of minimum balance requirements when closing accounts.

methods.name: testSavingsAccount_DELETE_APPLICATION
methods.description: Verifies deletion of savings account application in different states.

methods.name: testSavingsAccount_REJECT_APPLICATION
methods.description: Tests rejecting a savings account application with various validation scenarios.

methods.name: testSavingsAccount_WITHDRAW_APPLICATION
methods.description: Tests withdrawal scenarios for savings account applications.

methods.name: testSavingsAccountTransactions
methods.description: Validates deposit, withdrawal, adjust, undo, and transaction recovery functionalities.

methods.name: testSavingsAccountCharges
methods.description: Tests adding, updating, paying, waiving, inactivating charges, and handling due date related logic.

methods.name: testSavingsAccountWithOverdraft
methods.description: Tests overdrawn savings account operations, interest posting, and transaction effects.

methods.name: testSavingsAccountPostInterestOnLastDayWithOverdraft
methods.description: Verifies interest posting on last day of month with overdraft enabled, including deposit and withdrawal effects.

methods.name: testPostInterestAsOnSavingsAccountWithOverdraft
methods.description: Tests posting interest on overdraft savings accounts, expecting specific error when posting interest fails.

methods.name: testSavingsAccountPostInterestWithOverdraft
methods.description: Tests interest calculations post interest posting on overdraft accounts, with deposit and withdrawal impacts.

methods.name: testSavingsAccountBlockStatus
methods.description: Verifies account block and unblock status transitions, including account in various states and dormancy.

methods.name: activateSavingsAccount
methods.description: Helper method to activate a savings account with a specified date.

methods.name: createSavingsProduct
methods.description: Helper method to create a savings product with various configurations, including overdraft and dormancy.

methods.name: createTaxGroup
methods.description: Helper method to create a tax group with specified percentage.
